text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'Each bar is the quantile score with one idea removed minus the best guess' score, in points of capacity. A bar to the right means the forecast got worse without the idea. Line: 95% interval from resampling whole months. Grey band (Primary substations): the size of the difference between two fits of the same model. 292 daily forecast runs from July 2025 to June 2026, each forecasting up to 14 days ahead.'
text.tspan: Each bar is the quantile score with one idea removed minus the best guess' score, in points of capacity. A
bar to the right means the forecast got worse without the idea. Line: 95% interval from resampling whole
months. Grey band (Primary substations): the size of the difference between two fits of the same model. 292
daily forecast runs from July 2025 to June 2026, each forecasting up to 14 days ahead.
